groups.title: Ownership & Move Semantics
groups.question: Explain how Rust manages memory without a garbage collector.

followUps.Ownership Rules & the Drop Model: What happens to a value when its owner goes out of scope, and how does that help with OS handles?
followUps.Copy vs Clone: When is calling clone the right choice, and when is it a hidden performance cost?

groups.title: Borrowing & References
groups.question: Walk through the rules Rust applies when you borrow data instead of owning it.

followUps.Shared & Mutable References: Why does Rust forbid a mutable reference and a shared reference at the same time, even in single-threaded code?
followUps.Slices — Borrowing Contiguous Sequences: Why would a function take a &str instead of a String, and what does a slice actually hold?

groups.title: Lifetimes
groups.question: Explain what lifetimes are and why the compiler sometimes asks you to write them.

followUps.Lifetime Annotations & Elision: When can the compiler not infer a lifetime for a returned reference, and what does your annotation tell it?
followUps.Lifetime Bounds in Structs: What does a lifetime parameter on a struct guarantee, and what design cost can it bring?

groups.title: Stack & Heap in Rust
groups.question: Explain how you decide where data lives in a Rust program and what can go wrong with deep call stacks.

followUps.Box<T> — Heap Allocation: Why does a recursive type like a linked list need Box to compile?
followUps.Stack Overflows & Recursive Algorithms: Why can a recursive function pass all tests and still crash in production, and how would you fix it?
